name: ui-frames
goal: UI 프레임류 발주 — CSS 티 나는 UI를 실아트 프레임으로 교체(디렉터 피드백). 버튼·평가서 패널·주문표·타이머 프레임 + 트럭 짐칸 재발주(짐칸을 크게, 박스가 실리는 무대) + 세차 스펀지. 글자는 절대 굽지 않음(코드 렌더).
style: bold clean dark outlines, vibrant high-saturation colors, energetic comic cartoon sticker style, flat cel shading with one simple gloss highlight
common: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, 1024x1024 PNG with alpha, transparent background, single centered subject

items.label: 버튼 프레임(9-slice)
items.subject: a chunky rounded-rectangle game button frame in golden yellow with a darker bottom edge for depth and a soft top gloss, COMPLETELY EMPTY center area for code-rendered text, wide aspect button drawn large in frame

items.label: 평가서 패널
items.subject: a clipboard-style evaluation board: warm wood board with a metal clip at the top, a cream EMPTY paper sheet on it, portrait orientation, comic style

items.label: 주문표 패널
items.subject: a small order ticket memo pad: cream paper with a red header band and a clip, COMPLETELY EMPTY surface, landscape orientation

items.label: 타이머 프레임
items.subject: a horizontal capsule-shaped gauge frame, dark casing with metallic edge and small bolts, COMPLETELY EMPTY inner track, very wide aspect drawn large

items.label: 트럭 짐칸(재발주 — 크게)
items.subject: the open rear cargo bay of a delivery truck seen straight on and LARGE, plain cardboard boxes stacked along both inner walls leaving an inviting empty gap in the middle, the stage where thrown boxes land

items.label: 세차 스펀지
items.subject: a chunky yellow car-wash sponge with soap foam bubbling on its top side
